title: LiveSearch: Questions as Executable Verifier Code for a Live Benchmark of Professional-Source Financial Search Agents
title_zh: LiveSearch：以问题作为可执行验证代码的专业级金融搜索智能体实时基准

paragraphs.en: In finance, the answer that matters is usually the current one: prices, rates, and disclosures hold only as of a given day, so retrieving up-to-date facts is a core capability of a financial agent. Yet most financial benchmarks overlook timeliness. They fix each answer at annotation time, so the gold goes stale as markets move and, once leaked into training data, rewards recall rather than search and analysis. We introduce LiveSearch , a live benchmark that stores each question as executable verifier code : a typed program of calls to a professional financial data service, followed by a declarative extractor. The question is frozen, while its gold answer is determined by executing the program against professional financial data at evaluation time, and a daily job re-executes it with no human or language model in the loop. A memorized answer is thus likely outdated, and a model must reach the current one through tools and analysis. Construction is equally automatic: a language model only verbalizes programs enumerated from real tool responses and never chooses an answer. Under general web search, six contemporary tool-calling models reach 70.9 % 70.9\% – 76.7 % 76.7\% answer accuracy. Over three consecutive days, 70 % 70\% of served questions change their gold value, and even under tolerance-aware matching, a literally reused earlier snapshot fails on a majority of questions within a single day. Per-question tracking uncovers dynamic shifts in correctness masked by aggregate accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 在金融领域，真正重要的答案通常是最新的答案：价格、利率和披露信息仅在某一天内有效，因此获取最新事实是金融智能体的一项核心能力。 然而大多数金融基准测试忽视了时效性。 它们在标注时固定每个答案，因此随着市场变动，标准答案会过时；一旦泄露到训练数据中，这种做法奖励的是记忆而非搜索与分析。 我们提出 LiveSearch，这是一个动态（live）基准测试，它将每个问题存储为可执行的验证器代码：一个包含对专业金融数据服务调用的类型化程序，后接一个声明式提取器。 问题被固定下来，而其标准答案则通过在评测时对专业金融数据执行该程序来确定，并且一个每日任务会自动重新执行该程序，全程无需人工或语言模型参与。 因此，一个被记住的答案很可能已经过时，模型必须借助工具和分析来得出当前答案。 构建过程同样是全自动的：语言模型仅对从真实工具响应中枚举出的程序进行自然语言化表述，从不选择答案。 在通用网络搜索条件下，六个当代工具调用模型的答案准确率达到 70.9% – 76.7%。 在连续三天内，70% 的已提供问题的标准值发生了变化；即使采用容差感知的匹配方式，直接复用早前快照的答案也会在单日内于多数问题上失效。 逐题追踪揭示了被总体准确率所掩盖的正确性动态变化。

paragraphs.en: Large language models are now routinely deployed as search agents : given a natural-language question, the model plans a sequence of tool calls, reads the returned evidence, and composes an answer ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Qin et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., ) . Finance is a natural and high-value proving ground for such agents (questions are precise, answers are checkable, and the underlying data is abundant and structured), and the field has moved from domain-specific models and static task suites ( Wu et al., 2023 ; Xie et al., 2023 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2022 ; Islam et al., 2023 ) to agentic evaluation in which the model must retrieve its own evidence through search and tools ( Zeng et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Bigeard et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Luan et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Cao et al., 2026 ) . Finance is also, more than most domains, intrinsically time-sensitive : the answer an analyst actually needs (a latest price, an interest-rate spread, a newly filed fundamental, the current top holder) changes by the day or the minute, and a value that was correct at annotation time is often wrong a day later. What matters is therefore not only whether an agent can retrieve a fact, but whether it can retrieve the current one; the natural unit of ground truth in finance is a value that is re-established over time rather than written down once. Current benchmarks give up exactly this property. Despite differing in language, size, tool inventory, and task taxonomy, essentially all of these agentic benchmarks ( Zeng et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Bandi et al., 2026 ; Mo et al., 2026 ; Bigeard et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) share three weaknesses that turn out to be one weakness seen from three angles.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型如今已被常规地部署为搜索智能体：给定一个自然语言问题，模型会规划一系列工具调用，阅读返回的证据，并组织出答案 ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Qin et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., ) 。 金融是此类智能体天然且高价值的试验场（问题精确、答案可核查、底层数据丰富且结构化），该领域已从领域专用模型和静态任务套件 ( Wu et al., 2023 ; Xie et al., 2023 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2022 ; Islam et al., 2023 ) 发展到智能体化评测，即模型必须通过搜索和工具自行检索证据 ( Zeng et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Bigeard et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Luan et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Cao et al., 2026 ) 。 金融也比大多数领域更具内在的时效性：分析师真正需要的答案（最新价格、利差、新披露的基本面数据、当前第一大股东）每天甚至每分钟都在变化，标注时正确的数值往往一天之后就错了。 因此，关键不仅在于智能体能否检索到一个事实，还在于它能否检索到当前的事实；金融中真值的自然单元是随时间不断重新确立的数值，而非一次性写定的数值。 现有基准恰恰放弃了这一特性。 尽管在语言、规模、工具清单和任务分类上各不相同，这些智能体化基准 ( Zeng et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Bandi et al., 2026 ; Mo et al., 2026 ; Bigeard et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) 几乎全都存在三个弱点，而这三个弱点实际上是从三个角度看到的同一个弱点。

paragraphs.en: Curation is costly. Constructing financial agent benchmarks requires hundreds of expert-hours ( Zeng et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Bigeard et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , and without reusable answer-generation programs, every refresh repeats annotation and validation.

paragraphs.en: Static answers become stale. For time-sensitive queries, frozen reference answers silently go out of date and, once leaked, reward memorization rather than fresh retrieval ( White et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . FinSearchComp mitigates this with scripted updates, but only for its time-sensitive tier ( Hu et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 静态答案会过时。 对于时效性强的查询，固定的参考答案会悄然过时，且一旦泄露，只会奖励死记硬背而非最新的检索（White et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2026）。 FinSearchComp 通过脚本化更新缓解了这一问题，但仅针对其时效性子集（Hu et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: These challenges call for a unified mechanism that connects question construction, reference-answer generation, and ongoing updates. LiveSearch represents each question as a triple ( text , π , τ ) (\text{text},\pi,\tau) , where text is a fixed natural-language prompt, π \pi is an executable program over a professional financial data service, and τ \tau specifies how a candidate answer is matched to the program output. Each program comprises tool calls followed by a declarative extractor that selects and formats a single value. During construction, the pipeline enumerates candidate programs from observed tool responses and uses a language model to verbalize them; reference values are determined by execution. The same programs are then re-executed daily to produce dated gold snapshots without further language-model involvement. This design derives questions from professional data fields and metric definitions, makes reference answers traceable to explicit queries and extraction rules, and updates time-sensitive answers while keeping the question text fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 这些挑战需要一个统一机制，将问题构建、参考答案生成和持续更新连接起来。 LiveSearch 将每个问题表示为三元组 ( text , π , τ ) (\text{text},\pi,\tau)，其中 text 是固定的自然语言提示，π \pi 是一个基于专业金融数据服务的可执行程序，τ \tau 规定了候选答案与程序输出的匹配方式。 每个程序由若干工具调用和一个声明式提取器组成，后者用于选择并格式化单个值。 在构建过程中，流水线从观察到的工具响应中枚举候选程序，并使用语言模型将其表述为文字；参考值通过执行来确定。 随后，相同程序每天重新执行，无需语言模型进一步参与即可生成带日期的黄金快照。 这一设计使问题源自专业数据字段和指标定义，使参考答案可追溯至明确的查询和提取规则，并在保持问题文本不变的同时更新时效性答案。

paragraphs.en: For web search agents, the challenge is not just finding a relevant page: online evidence can mix stale and current values, reporting periods, and metric definitions. LiveSearch evaluates ordinary web search and page retrieval against reference answers refreshed from professional data, testing whether agents can recover the current, precisely specified fact from a changing Web rather than recall a once-correct answer.
paragraphs.zh: 对于网络搜索智能体来说，挑战不仅在于找到相关页面：在线证据可能混杂着过时与当前的数值、不同的报告期以及不同的指标定义。 LiveSearch 将普通网络搜索和网页检索与从专业数据刷新的参考答案进行对比评估，测试智能体能否从不断变化的网络中恢复当前的、被精确定义的事实，而不是回忆起一个曾经正确的答案。

sents.en: LiveSearch evaluates ordinary web search and page retrieval against reference answers refreshed from professional data, testing whether agents can recover the current, precisely specified fact from a changing Web rather than recall a once-correct answer.
sents.zh: LiveSearch 将普通网络搜索和网页检索与从专业数据刷新的参考答案进行对比评估，测试智能体能否从不断变化的网络中恢复当前的、被精确定义的事实，而不是回忆起一个曾经正确的答案。

paragraphs.en: A live benchmark for financial search agents. Each question is paired with an executable reference program over professional financial data tools and a fixed answer-matching rule. A snapshot-and-freeze protocol binds each question to a timestamp and a frozen gold value. We report six models’ scores under web search and measure answer accuracy and temporal changes in gold answers (Sections 3.1 and 4 ).

paragraphs.en: Domain-specific models and static evaluation suites ( Wu et al., 2023 ; Xie et al., 2023 ; Xie et al., 2024 ) and report-grounded QA resources such as FinQA, ConvFinQA, and FinanceBench ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2022 ; Islam et al., 2023 ) made financial competence a measurable target, but they evaluate reasoning over frozen text and tables rather than interaction with live tools. The Finance Agent Benchmark ( Bigeard et al., 2025 ) (537 expert-authored questions over US equities and SEC filings) and FinGAIA ( Zeng et al., 2025 ) (407 Chinese expert tasks in a GAIA style) are fully manual and static; the former defends against contamination with a private test split and post-cutoff documents rather than with freshness. FinSearchComp ( Hu et al., 2025 ) is the closest work: 635 635 bilingual expert questions in three tiers, with a time-sensitive tier whose reference values are regenerated by fixed scripts after market close. Its question pool is static and its complex tier is deliberately historical, so time sensitivity and professional grounding are never combined.

paragraphs.en: Concurrent benchmarks push finance agents toward richer tool use and richer scoring: FinToolBench pairs hundreds of runnable free-tier tools with tool-required questions and audits call-level compliance, FrontierFinance scores long-form analyst queries against thousands of expert-written, source-attributed rubrics, and FinTrace grades whole tool-calling trajectories rather than final answers ( Lu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Cao et al., 2026 ) . These works improve how an agent’s behaviour is measured and are complementary to ours. Their item is still a (text, answer-or-rubric) pair written once by humans or by a one-off synthesis pass, so the pool ages as the market moves, refreshing it means re-annotating it, and the evidence is free-tier or web-tier. LiveSearch stores the item as executable code over professional data tools, so the gold answer is re-derived daily by execution, contamination decay is measurable per question, and no human or language model decides a gold answer in either curation or refresh. It thus occupies the quadrant that is both time-sensitive and professional-source-grounded.
paragraphs.zh: 并发基准测试推动金融智能体走向更丰富的工具使用与更丰富的评分：FinToolBench 将数百个可运行的免费层工具与需要工具的问题配对，并审计调用层面的合规性；FrontierFinance 针对数千条由专家撰写、注明来源的评分细则对长篇分析师查询进行评分；FinTrace 则对整个工具调用轨迹而非最终答案进行评分（Lu et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026；Cao et al., 2026）。 这些工作改进了对智能体行为的度量方式，与我们的工作互补。 它们的题目仍然是（文本、答案或评分细则）对，由人类一次性撰写或通过一次性的合成过程生成，因此随着市场变动，题库会老化，刷新题库意味着重新标注，且其证据来自免费层或网络层。 LiveSearch 将题目存储为基于专业数据工具的可执行代码，因此标准答案每天通过执行重新推导，每个问题的污染衰减都可度量，并且在整理或刷新过程中，均无需人类或语言模型来决定标准答案。 因此，它占据了既时间敏感又以专业来源为依据的那个象限。

paragraphs.en: LiveBench ( White et al., 2025 ) limits contamination by periodically adding questions drawn from recent sources and scoring them against objective ground truth. EvoBrowseComp ( Wang et al., 2026 ) identifies the analogous leakage problem for search agents, whose static questions can enter training data or be solved from parametric memory, and addresses it by synthesizing fresh English and Chinese questions through live-web traversal and periodically regenerating the pool. In both, the unit of refresh is the question set. LiveSearch instead freezes the question text and refreshes the answer by re-executing its program. Finance motivates this choice: “the latest disclosed return on equity of company X” stays well-posed indefinitely while its answer changes every reporting period. Keeping the question also makes a single question’s answer drift, and the decay of a memorized answer, observable over time.
paragraphs.zh: LiveBench（White 等，2025）通过定期添加取自近期来源的题目并依据客观标准答案进行评分，来限制污染。 EvoBrowseComp（Wang 等，2026）针对搜索智能体识别出类似的泄漏问题——其静态题目可能进入训练数据或从参数记忆中被解答——并通过实时网页遍历合成全新的英文和中文题目、定期重新生成题库来加以解决。 在这两项工作中，刷新的单位都是题集。 LiveSearch 则冻结题目文本，并通过重新执行其程序来刷新答案。 金融领域正是这一选择的动因：「公司 X 最近披露的净资产收益率」这一问法始终保持良构，而其答案在每个报告期都会变化。 保留题目还能使单个题目的答案漂移以及记忆答案的衰减随时间变得可观察。

paragraphs.en: Outside finance, several works synthesize questions for search agents: WebDancer’s CRAWLQA and E2HQA, WebSailor’s rare-entity knowledge-graph random walks with obfuscation, and WebWalker’s website-traversal QA ( Wu et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025b ) . None is finance-specific and none refreshes its answers, but together they show that high-quality agent questions can be synthesized rather than hand-written. Program-to-question generation and schema-driven synthetic QA have also been studied in semantic parsing ( Guo et al., 2018 ; Xu et al., 2020 ) . LiveSearch applies this idea to a setting where the synthesized artifact is an executable program whose answer is verifiable against live professional data.
paragraphs.zh: 在金融领域之外，一些工作为搜索智能体合成问题：WebDancer 的 CRAWLQA 和 E2HQA、WebSailor 的带混淆的稀有实体知识图谱随机游走，以及 WebWalker 的网站遍历问答（Wu et al., 2025a；Li et al., 2025；Wu et al., 2025b）。 这些工作都不是专门针对金融的，也都不会刷新其答案，但它们共同表明，高质量的智能体问题可以通过合成而非人工撰写的方式获得。 程序到问题的生成以及基于模式的合成问答在语义解析中也已有研究（Guo et al., 2018；Xu et al., 2020）。 LiveSearch 将这一思想应用于一个设定，其中被合成的产物是一个可执行程序，其答案可以对照实时专业数据进行验证。

paragraphs.en: A claim-level LLM judge with conjunctive scoring has been adopted independently by the Finance Agent Benchmark ( Bigeard et al., 2025 ) , LiveMCPBench ( Mo et al., 2026 ) , and MCP-Atlas ( Bandi et al., 2026 ) . Because each of our questions resolves to one authoritative value, our metric is the single-claim case: a binary judgment against the gold value, with numeric-tolerance matching following FinSearchComp. Our harness fixes the judge within each run and draws it from a model family absent from the leaderboard, since LLM judges are known to favour their own family and to show position and verbosity biases ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 一种采用合取评分的声明级大语言模型裁判已被 Finance Agent Benchmark（Bigeard 等，2025）、LiveMCPBench（Mo 等，2026）和 MCP-Atlas（Bandi 等，2026）独立采用。 由于我们的每个问题都解析为一个权威值，我们的指标是单声明情形：针对金标准值的二元判断，并按照 FinSearchComp 采用数值容差匹配。 我们的评测框架在每次运行中固定裁判模型，并从排行榜中不存在的模型家族中选取，因为已知大语言模型裁判会偏袒自己的家族，并表现出位置偏差和冗长偏差（Zheng 等，2023）。

paragraphs.en: LiveSearch stores each question as a triple ( text , π , τ ) (\text{text},\pi,\tau) and organizes construction and maintenance into two stages. Section 3.1 defines the question representation, Section 3.2 describes the underlying data service and benchmark scope, and Sections 3.3 and 3.4 detail the two stages (Figure 1 ). Stage 1 builds an initial question inventory by querying financial data tools, enumerating candidate programs from their responses, and using a language model to screen candidates and generate question text. Reference answers are computed by executing the programs. Stage 2 selects the evaluation pool from this inventory and then refreshes its reference answers daily, without further language-model involvement. paragraphs.en: A question record stores the frozen question text, the executable gold program π \pi whose execution defines the answer, the matching rule τ \tau , and metadata (Figure 2 ). The program is a short typed DAG: one or more tool-call steps followed by a declarative extractor that turns the raw response into one formatted value. The extractor language has no branches or expressions, so replaying a program is deterministic and every program can be checked mechanically. An extractor names a path into the response, a selection rule, a field, an optional aggregate, and a format (type, decimals, scale, unit). The selection rule’s select.mode ∈ \in { latest , snapshot , match , minute , all } encodes the time anchor : latest over a trade_date field means “as of the most recent trading day,” so the selected row, and with it the answer, rolls forward as new data arrives; match pins one row of a cross-sectional table by an identity key; snapshot reads a single-record response. Each record also carries a refresh_class ∈ \in {daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual, static}, the cadence at which its answer is expected to change.
paragraphs.zh: 问题记录存储冻结的问题文本、可执行的黄金程序 π \pi（其执行结果定义答案）、匹配规则 τ \tau，以及元数据（图 2）。 该程序是一个短的类型化有向无环图（DAG）：一个或多个工具调用步骤，后接一个声明式提取器，将原始响应转换为一个格式化的值。 提取器语言没有分支或表达式，因此重放程序是确定性的，并且每个程序都可以被机械地检查。 提取器指明响应中的路径、选择规则、字段、可选的聚合操作以及格式（类型、小数位数、缩放、单位）。 选择规则的 select.mode ∈ \in {latest, snapshot, match, minute, all} 编码了时间锚点：作用于 trade_date 字段的 latest 意为“截至最近的交易日”，因此所选行以及随之而来的答案会随新数据到达而向前滚动；match 通过标识键固定横截面表中的一行；snapshot 读取单条记录的响应。 每条记录还携带一个 refresh_class ∈ \in {daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual, static}，即其答案预期发生变化的频率。

paragraphs.en: The matching rule τ \tau is one of exact , approx , or semantic , and states how an answer is compared with the gold value. exact rounds the answer to the gold value’s precision; approx accepts agreement at the coarser of the two precisions (at least two decimals), an unrounded form of the gold value, or a relative error within a fixed tolerance; and semantic accepts an equivalent meaning. Both numeric rules normalize units first, and a sign or direction mismatch fails under every rule. The rule is fixed at construction: the language model proposes one, and the pipeline clamps it mechanically, allowing exact only when nothing marks the value as derived (a percentage unit, a tool display coarser than the rendering, or a lossy rendering).
paragraphs.zh: 匹配规则 τ \tau 是 exact、approx 或 semantic 之一，用于说明答案如何与标准值（gold value）进行比较。exact 将答案四舍五入到标准值的精度；approx 接受两者中较粗精度（至少两位小数）下的一致、标准值的未舍入形式，或在固定容差范围内的相对误差；semantic 接受等价的含义。 两种数值规则都会先对单位进行归一化，而符号或方向不匹配在任何规则下都判为失败。 规则在构建时即已固定：由语言模型提出一条规则，流水线对其进行机械式的钳制，只有当没有任何迹象表明该值是推导得出时（例如百分比单位、比呈现更粗的工具显示，或有损的呈现方式），才允许使用 exact。

paragraphs.en: An automated gate rejects any question whose text contains an absolute date, including Chinese date and quarter forms. Questions refer to time only relatively (“the most recent trading day,” “the latest disclosed reporting period”), and the concrete window lives only in the program’s arguments, which the daily refresh rewrites. The same frozen sentence therefore has a new correct answer every day the underlying series moves.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化门控会拒绝任何文本中包含绝对日期的问题，包括中文日期和季度形式。 问题只以相对方式指代时间（“最近的交易日”“最新披露的报告期”），具体的时间窗口只存在于程序的参数中，每日刷新会重写这些参数。 因此，同一句冻结的问题，在底层数据序列发生变动的每一天，都会有新的正确答案。

paragraphs.en: Because gold answers change by design, the unit of comparison is not a file but a tuple: (question, timestamp, frozen gold value). Each daily refresh writes a dated, immutable snapshot gold_answers_<date>.jsonl that records, per question, the formatted answer, the raw value, the observed period, and the arguments actually sent, so every gold value can be traced to the call that produced it. An evaluation run cites the snapshot date it scored against. Question identifiers are content hashes of the tool, entity, non-date arguments, and extractor rather than positions, so a question keeps its identity across regenerations. A same-date leaderboard comparison requires identical qid sets and gold dates; a longitudinal audit instead fixes the qids and explicitly tracks each date’s own frozen gold values. The evaluator is strict: the snapshot must cover every served qid, contain no unknown qids, and carry no empty or error-flagged answers, or the run fails rather than falling back to a stale value.
paragraphs.zh: 由于标准答案按设计会随时间变化，比较的基本单元不是文件，而是一个元组：(问题、时间戳、冻结的标准值)。 每次每日刷新都会写入一个带日期、不可变的快照文件 gold_answers_<date>.jsonl，其中针对每个问题记录格式化后的答案、原始值、观测周期以及实际发送的参数，因此每个标准值都可以追溯到产生它的那次调用。 每次评测运行都会引用其评分所依据的快照日期。 问题标识符是工具、实体、非日期参数以及抽取器的内容哈希，而非位置序号，因此一个问题在多次重新生成之间能够保持其身份。 同日排行榜比较要求完全相同的 qid 集合和标准日期；而纵向审计则固定 qid 集合，并显式跟踪每个日期各自冻结的标准值。 评测器非常严格：快照必须覆盖每一个被服务的 qid，不得包含未知的 qid，也不得带有空答案或错误标记的答案，否则该次运行将直接失败，而不会回退到过期的值。

paragraphs.en: We organize the financial universe into a two-level taxonomy with eight level-1 asset categories (Cash & Monetary; Credit & Financing; Equity & Ownership; Physical & Alternative; Risk Transfer & Derivatives; Composite & Structured Products; Foreign Exchange; and Indices, Benchmarks & Reference Rates), each split into level-2 subcategories, plus two cross-cutting axes. Every subcategory names an entity_sampling_source , the registry or feed from which real instruments can be drawn (e.g. SEC EDGAR CIK lists and exchange listings for listed equity, CNINFO and ChinaBond for Chinese bonds, AMAC for funds). The two axes are the ones a live benchmark needs: a corporate-action and event axis (earnings, dividends, splits, M&A, defaults), whose events arrive daily and drive freshness, and an entity layer (issuers, intermediaries, funds, infrastructure, regulators, key persons) that lists the kinds of entity a question can be keyed on. The taxonomy fixes the benchmark’s scope. Our questions are drawn from the domains that the data source serves well: listed equities, funds, indices, macro series, market microstructure, and corporate events. Derivatives, FX, commodities, insurance, and structured credit lie outside the current scope.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将金融领域组织为一个两级分类体系，包含八个一级资产类别（现金与货币；信用与融资；权益与所有权；实物与另类；风险转移与衍生品；复合与结构化产品；外汇；以及指数、基准与参考利率），每个一级类别再细分为二级子类别，另加两个横切维度。 每个子类别都指定一个 entity_sampling_source，即可从中抽取真实金融工具的注册库或数据源（例如： 上市股票对应的 SEC EDGAR CIK 名单与交易所上市名单，中国债券对应的巨潮资讯网（CNINFO）与中债（ChinaBond），基金对应的中基协（AMAC））。 这两个维度是实时基准测试所必需的：一个是公司行为与事件维度（财报、分红、拆股、并购、违约），其事件每日到达并驱动时效性；另一个是实体层（发行人、中介机构、基金、基础设施、监管机构、关键人物），列出问题可以锚定的实体类型。 该分类体系固定了基准测试的范围。 我们的问题取自数据源服务良好的领域：上市股票、基金、指数、宏观序列、市场微观结构以及公司事件。 衍生品、外汇、大宗商品、保险和结构化信贷不在当前范围之内。

sents.en: Derivatives, FX, commodities, insurance, and structured credit lie outside the current scope.
sents.zh: 衍生品、外汇、大宗商品、保险和结构化信贷不在当前范围之内。

paragraphs.en: The pipeline calls tools first, observes real responses, and only then derives questions whose answers are executed values, so the model never writes a gold number.
paragraphs.zh: 该流程首先调用工具，观察真实响应，然后才推导出答案为实际执行值的问题，因此模型从不编写黄金数值（gold number）。

paragraphs.en: For each asset class (A-share, Hong Kong and US equities, indices, exchange-traded and off-exchange funds), a probe samples entities and marks a tool as usable for the class when a strict majority of them return data; entity-free tools such as macro series are probed once. Coverage then draws, for every usable tool, an entity at each of eleven web-visibility levels, moving to another entity at the same level whenever a call returns no data, so every kept call is backed by a tool that actually serves its entity. An entity’s web-visibility index (0–10) counts the web search results for its name that mention it, which spreads the pool from obscure to well-known instruments instead of concentrating it on popular ones.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每类资产（A股、港股和美股、指数、场内及场外基金），探针会对实体进行抽样，当其中严格多数能返回数据时，将该工具标记为可用于该类资产；对于宏观经济序列等无实体的工具，则只探测一次。 然后，覆盖环节为每个可用工具在十一个网络可见度等级中的每一级抽取一个实体，只要某次调用未返回数据，就换用同一等级的另一个实体，从而保证每条保留的调用都有真正能服务其实体的工具支撑。 实体的网络可见度指数（0–10）统计网络搜索结果中提及该实体的条目数，这使实体池从冷门工具分布到知名工具，而不是集中于热门品种。

paragraphs.en: For each observed response, the pipeline enumerates every extractor that the extractor language can execute to a non-null value: latest over each rolling field of a dated series, match on an identity key for cross-sectional tables, and snapshot for single-record responses. Mechanical filters reject metadata, pagination, and display fields, result-set counts, fields of tools whose data are static (a value that never changes cannot drift), and latest selectors whose newest period holds conflicting values. A language model then reviews each remaining target for whether it is worth asking. The verdict is keyed by a semantic signature , namely the tool, its non-entity arguments, the extractor structure, and the refresh cadence, and is shared by every entity with that signature. Question diversity is thus a property of the enumeration, not of model behaviour.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个观测到的响应，流水线会枚举该提取器语言可执行并产出非空值的每一种提取器：对带日期序列的每个滚动字段取 latest，对横截面表按身份键做 match，对单条记录的响应取 snapshot。 机械过滤器会剔除元数据、分页与展示字段、结果集计数、数据为静态的工具字段（永不变化的值不可能发生漂移），以及最新周期中存在相互冲突取值的 latest 选择器。 随后由语言模型审查每个剩余的目标，判断其是否值得提问。 判定结果以语义签名为键，即工具本身、其非实体参数、提取器结构以及刷新节奏，并且由具有该签名的所有实体共享。 因此，问题的多样性是枚举过程的属性，而非模型行为的属性。

paragraphs.en: For each kept signature, one language-model call sees an observed response together with the fixed extractor and writes the question text, a one-sentence conclusion, the time anchor, the rendering format, and a proposed matching rule; it cannot change which row or field is selected. The gold answer is computed by executing the extractor. A candidate is kept only if (i) the executed value agrees with the value the model states, within 1 % 1\% for numeric answers; (ii) the rendered unit agrees with the tool’s own display string for that field; and (iii) the text contains no absolute date, no reference to hidden tool context, and no tool or field name. Rejected candidates are retried with the rejection reason as feedback. The accepted template is then bound to every other entity with the same signature by substituting names and codes, and the checks run again on each binding. A final pass rewrites ambiguous phrasings and keeps the original text for audit, and a validator checks that the question text, the call arguments, and the extractor’s row filter all name the same entity; refresh and evaluation repeat this check. The resulting inventory holds 3,320 questions over 34 tools. An optional tool-necessity gate, in which a tool-using agent must succeed over k = 3 k{=}3 runs while a model without tools must fail, can further tighten the inventory when a stricter pool is desired.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个保留的签名，一次语言模型调用会将观测到的响应与固定的提取器一起读取，并写出问题文本、一句结论、时间锚点、呈现格式以及提议的匹配规则；它不能更改所选的行或字段。 标准答案通过执行提取器来计算。 候选项只有在满足以下条件时才被保留：(i) 执行值与模型陈述的值一致，数值答案在 1\% 1\% 以内；(ii) 呈现的单位与该字段工具自身显示的字符串一致；(iii) 文本不包含绝对日期、不引用隐藏的工具上下文，也不包含工具名或字段名。 被拒绝的候选项会以拒绝原因作为反馈进行重试。 随后，通过替换名称和代码，将已接受的模板绑定到具有相同签名的每个其他实体，并在每次绑定时重新运行检查。 最后的环节会改写含糊的表述并保留原文以供审计，同时一个验证器会检查问题文本、调用参数以及提取器的行过滤条件是否都指向同一实体；刷新和评估会重复此检查。 最终得到的问题库包含针对 34 个工具的 3,320 个问题。 一个可选的工具必要性门槛可以进一步收紧问题库，以便在需要更严格的池时使用：使用工具的智能体必须在 k = 3 k{=}3 次运行中成功，而不使用工具的模型则必须失败。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation pool is drawn from the daily-cadence part of the inventory without any language-model call. Signatures that every model answered correctly in a preliminary five-model run are dropped. Each remaining signature is re-instantiated on fresh entities spread over the eleven web-visibility levels: each new entity is probed once (one call serves every signature that shares it), the signature’s extractor is reused unchanged, and the question text is the signature’s template with the entity substituted. Entities are assigned so that a signature appears in both a test and a training split while no entity appears in both. Entity-free macro questions are reused as they are.

paragraphs.en: The daily job re-executes every program in the pool. It rebuilds each call’s time window from the benchmark date rather than the machine clock, changing only date arguments, and anchors US equities to the last settled session rather than an unsettled current-session bar. Scoring a past run always uses the frozen snapshot of its date rather than re-querying historical data. It then runs the program through the shared execution layer, applies the extractor, and writes the dated snapshot. A question whose entity has no data that day (for instance, no block trades in the window) is left out of that day’s served set but stays in the frozen pool, because event-driven data can return later. How often a question’s answer flips and how often it fails to resolve are reportable properties of the benchmark; questions that fail repeatedly are candidates for retirement. Section 4.3 measures the flip rate.
paragraphs.zh: 该每日任务会重新执行池中的每个程序。 它以基准日期而非机器时钟重建每次调用的时间窗口，只修改日期参数，并将美股锚定在最近一个已结算的交易时段，而非未结算的当前时段K线。 对历史运行的评分总是使用其日期的冻结快照，而不是重新查询历史数据。 随后它通过共享执行层运行该程序，应用抽取器，并写入带日期的快照。 当天实体没有数据的问题（例如，窗口内没有大宗交易）会被排除在当天的服务集合之外，但仍保留在冻结池中，因为事件驱动的数据可能会在之后返回。 一个问题的答案翻转频率和无法解析频率是基准的可报告属性；反复失败的问题是淘汰候选。 第4.3节测量了翻转率。

paragraphs.en: For the temporal and failure analyses, the agent runs in a ReAct-style tool-calling loop ( Yao et al., 2023 ) with two generic web tools, web search and page fetch, and at most 15 15 turns. Its system prompt gives the benchmark date, which the relative time anchors require, and instructs the agent to use tool-returned evidence rather than parametric memory. The episode ends when the agent replies without a tool call; at the turn limit the tools are withdrawn and the agent must give its best answer. Scoring reads this final reply, and an empty reply scores 0 0 . The professional data source is not exposed to the agent: it only executes the gold programs, so the evaluation measures whether an agent with ordinary web search can recover a value established from a professional source. Because the question text is tool-agnostic, giving the agent the professional tools on the same questions would measure how far web search substitutes for professional data; we leave that condition to future work.
paragraphs.zh: 在时序与故障分析中，智能体以 ReAct 风格的工具调用循环（Yao et al., 2023）运行，配备两个通用网页工具（网页搜索和页面抓取），至多进行 15 轮。 其系统提示词给出基准测试日期（相对时间锚点需要该日期），并指示智能体使用工具返回的证据而非参数记忆。 当智能体在不调用工具的情况下作出回复时，该回合即结束；在轮数上限处，工具被撤回，智能体必须给出其最佳答案。 评分读取这一最终回复，空回复计 0 分。 专业数据源不对智能体开放：它只执行金标准程序，因此该评估衡量的是拥有普通网页搜索能力的智能体能否还原由专业数据源确定的数值。 由于问题文本与工具无关，在同一批问题上向智能体提供专业工具将衡量网页搜索能在多大程度上替代专业数据；我们将该条件留待未来工作。

paragraphs.en: The distinction also explains what “latest” means operationally. For all 18 18 US-equity programs, the request’s end_date is September 11, 14, and 15 for benchmark dates September 14, 15, and 16, respectively, reflecting the last settled session. For Hong Kong stock 08033.HK, the volume changes from 372,000 372{,}000 to 50,000 50{,}000 shares and then repeats; the last two snapshots both report September 15 as the observed period even though the request window advances to September 16. In contrast, an RMB deposit-rate program retains 1.30 % 1.30\% and a January 15 observation throughout, while its query_date advances daily. These are different time anchors, not a requirement to return a number bearing the benchmark date. An agent that substitutes an unsettled quote or a zero-volume calendar-day row can therefore answer a different question from the one the program defines.

paragraphs.en: We further track archived single-run trajectories of three models, DeepSeek V4 Pro (0813), Kimi K3, and GLM-5.3 (agent configurations separate from Table 1 ), each scored against its own date’s gold snapshot. We compare the September 14 and 16 endpoints; September 15 is omitted because the page-fetch tool was unavailable during that day’s runs. paragraphs.en: Figure 6 partitions the same panel into 56 56 questions whose formatted gold differs between endpoints and 29 29 whose endpoint gold agrees. Within the changed-gold group, DeepSeek gains 11 11 correct items and loses 5 5 , increasing from 36 / 56 36/56 to 42 / 56 42/56 ; Kimi gains and loses 8 8 , remaining at 39 / 56 39/56 ; GLM gains 10 10 and loses 7 7 , increasing from 38 / 56 38/56 to 41 / 56 41/56 . paragraphs.en: Not every question separates models. In an 86 86 -question pilot, answered by 11 11 models with web search and page fetch under a fixed judge, 41 41 questions were solved by every model and 10 10 by none, leaving 35 35 that split the field. The discriminating questions concentrate on confusable financial calibers and edge-market microstructure (e.g. return on equity via get_financial_index , block-trade detail, Hong Kong and US K-lines), whereas plain A-share balance-sheet and K-line questions are solved by nearly every model. Difficulty thus sits where the design places it, in resolving the right field and caliber among near-synonyms. Pool selection (Section 3.4 ) uses the same signal by dropping signatures that every model solves.
paragraphs.zh: 并非每个问题都能区分不同模型。 在一项包含86个问题的试点中，由11个模型在固定裁判下结合网页搜索与页面抓取作答，其中41个问题被所有模型解出，10个问题无一模型解出，剩下的35个问题则区分了各模型。 具有区分性的问题集中于易混淆的金融口径和边缘市场微观结构（例如通过 get_financial_index 获取净资产收益率、大宗交易明细、港股与美股K线），而简单的A股资产负债表与K线问题几乎每个模型都能解出。 因此，难度恰好位于设计所设定的位置，即从近义术语中辨析正确的字段与口径。 题库筛选（第3.4节）采用相同的信号，剔除所有模型都能解出的题目特征。

sents.zh: 具有区分性的问题集中于易混淆的金融口径和边缘市场微观结构（例如通过 get_financial_index 获取净资产收益率、大宗交易明细、港股与美股K线），而简单的A股资产负债表与K线问题几乎每个模型都能解出。

sents.en: Difficulty thus sits where the design places it, in resolving the right field and caliber among near-synonyms.
sents.zh: 因此，难度恰好位于设计所设定的位置，即从近义术语中辨析正确的字段与口径。

sents.en: Pool selection (Section 3.4 ) uses the same signal by dropping signatures that every model solves.
sents.zh: 题库筛选（第3.4节）采用相同的信号，剔除所有模型都能解出的题目特征。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation trajectories show that errors rarely come from a lack of searching: agents typically issue several searches and cross-check two or three pages before answering. The errors come instead from mismatches between what public pages present and what the question specifies. (i) Precisely defined calibers. Back-adjusted prices of Hong Kong stocks depend on the adjustment method, so a value read from a portal that adjusts differently, or recomputed from a split history, misses the gold; for counts of moving-average crossings, agents compute their own count under their own definition; and for the daily trading value of US stocks, agents approximate it as volume times closing price instead of retrieving the reported value. (ii) A different “latest” session. For an illiquid Hong Kong stock, the latest trading session is the most recent one with trades, but agents report the zero-volume calendar day shown on public pages. (iii) Unverified secondary values. Agents sometimes report a third-party quote without checking the issuing source; for the two-year Chinese government bond yield, agents that used an aggregator’s figure ( 1.247 % 1.247\% ) missed the official curve value ( 1.2439 % 1.2439\% ) that other agents found. Under web search, then, the hard part is matching the exact caliber and period that the question defines.
paragraphs.zh: 评估轨迹显示，错误很少源于检索不足：智能体通常会进行多次搜索，并在回答前交叉核对两三个页面。 错误反而来自公开页面所呈现的内容与问题所规定的内容之间的不匹配。 (i) 精确定义的口径。 港股的后复权价格取决于复权方法，因此从采用不同复权方式的门户读取的数值，或根据拆股历史重新计算的数值，会偏离官方基准；对于均线交叉次数，智能体按各自定义自行计算；对于美股每日成交额，智能体用成交量乘以收盘价来近似，而不是检索官方报告的数值。 (ii) 不同的“最新”交易日。 对于一只流动性差的港股，最新交易日是有成交记录的最近交易日，但智能体报告的是公开页面显示的零成交日历日。 (iii) 未经核实的二手数值。 智能体有时会报告第三方报价而不核查其发布来源；对于两年期中国政府债券收益率，使用聚合商数值（1.247%）的智能体错过了其他智能体找到的官方曲线数值（1.2439%）。 因此，在网络搜索条件下，难点在于匹配问题所定义的确切口径和期间。

paragraphs.en: LiveSearch turns a financial search benchmark from a fixed test set into a live measurement instrument by storing each question as executable verifier code over professional financial data tools. The question text is frozen and the gold answer is the program’s live output, so automated curation and a daily refresh without any language model follow from one representation, and the model verbalizes but never decides the answer. Under general web search, six contemporary models reach 70.9 % 70.9\% – 76.7 % 76.7\% answer accuracy. Over three consecutive days, 70 % 70\% of served questions change their gold value, and literal snapshot reuse fails on a majority of questions at both one-day transitions even under the fixed matching rules. Per-question tracking further shows that aggregate accuracy can stay flat while individual verdicts turn over, a signal that only stable question identities and dated gold snapshots expose. The approach is not specific to finance: any domain with a stable programmatic data interface can host a live, auto-refreshing benchmark built the same way.
paragraphs.zh: LiveSearch 通过将每道题存储为基于专业金融数据工具的可执行验证代码，把一个金融搜索基准从固定测试集转变为实时测量工具。 题目文本被冻结，标准答案即程序的实时输出，因此自动化策展与每日刷新无需任何语言模型便可由这一表示直接推出，模型只负责表述答案而从不决定答案。 在通用网页搜索下，六个当代模型的答案准确率为 70.9 % 70.9\% – 76.7 % 76.7\%。 在连续三天内，70 % 70\% 的已服务题目的标准值发生了变化，且即使在固定匹配规则下，字面快照复用在两次单日转换中都在多数题目上失败。 逐题追踪进一步表明，总体准确率可以保持平稳而个别判定却在更替，这一信号只有通过稳定的题目身份与带日期的标准快照才能揭示。 该方法并不局限于金融领域：任何拥有稳定程序化数据接口的领域都可以用同样的方式构建实时、自动刷新的基准。

paragraphs.en: The data source serves equities, funds, indices, macro, microstructure, and corporate events well, and derivatives, FX, commodities, insurance, and structured credit weakly or not at all, so our claims about professional-source grounding are limited to the covered domains. The data source is also a proprietary service that external researchers cannot call freely. We mitigate this with documented tool input/output schemas, frozen timestamped gold snapshots (the shareable (question, timestamp, value) tuples), and gated evaluation access; live re-execution requires the service. Gold values also inherit the accuracy of the upstream professional source.
paragraphs.zh: 该数据源对股票、基金、指数、宏观、微观结构和公司事件覆盖良好，而对衍生品、外汇、大宗商品、保险和结构化信用产品覆盖薄弱或完全没有，因此我们关于专业数据源依据性的结论仅限于所覆盖的领域。 该数据源也是一项专有服务，外部研究者无法自由调用。 我们通过记录在案的工具输入/输出模式、冻结并带时间戳的黄金快照（即可共享的（问题、时间戳、数值）元组）以及受控的评测访问权限来缓解这一问题；实时重新执行则需要该服务。 黄金数值也会继承上游专业数据源的准确性。

paragraphs.en: Scoring also depends on an LLM judge. Fixing its configuration within a run and using a model family absent from the leaderboard is intended to limit bias, but does not eliminate judge error or the position and verbosity effects known in LLM-based evaluation ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 评分还依赖于一个 LLM 评判者。 在一次运行内固定其配置，并使用排行榜中未出现的模型系列，旨在限制偏差，但这并不能消除评判者的错误，也无法消除基于 LLM 的评估中已知的位置效应和冗长效应（Zheng et al., 2023）。
